tasks.short: Present information using interactive and audiovisual equipment

steps.what: Choose suitable information and verify accessibility for the actual kindergarten pupils
Set and check display size, audio levels and presentation equipment
Present information in audiovisual or interactive formats using the actual equipment
Adapt pace, explanation and equipment use to pupils' actual responses

tasks.design: Test saved accessibility profiles in the presentation application in {OTHER}. Reuse only teacher-selected display and audio settings, retaining content selection, actual equipment checks, live presentation and responsive adaptation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated setting entry accompanies hands-on accessibility and teaching work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native presentation profiles can reuse specified display and audio values.
tasks.still_hard: Making information accessible and meaningful to pupils with different support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Notice actual pupil responses and adapt instruction appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less setting entry with unchanged teaching responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: presentation applications can retain display and audio settings; accessibility suitability and live teaching still require the teacher.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a classroom that currently repeats settings. OTHER is the audiovisual presentation application and equipment. Existing automatic settings have no labour-saving baseline.
The teacher chooses content, display size and audio settings from actual pupil needs in s1-s2. No pupil diagnosis, automatic emotion inference or free content producer is assumed.
Native profiles are tested first. Only 2 of 10 setting-entry points are removed; 8 remain for hardware setup, physical checks, exceptions and correction. More equipment repair lowers the estimate.

No new class-progress record is introduced. Actual material creation is not hidden in the teaching time; this task uses existing selected materials. Any real separate public upload or message requires its own counted gated action.
unknowns: Actual repeated settings and equipment profile support
research_questions: Observe audiovisual setup and time repeated values separately from equipment and accessibility checks.

incremental.description: Maintain saved profiles and check changed classroom equipment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2 repeated setting points less 0.5 upkeep. Visiting equipment supports only 0.8 points of ordinary display-setting reuse; retain other setup and pupil-specific audio checks: 0.8 minus 0.5 = 0.3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend professional meetings and teacher training

steps.what: Read the actual professional meeting or teacher-training materials
Attend professional meetings, educational conferences or teacher-training workshops

tasks.design: Retain professional participation and separately counted reading of real materials in {DOCS} or {LMS}. Native access already provides them in this attendance scenario, and no template substitutes for the teacher's own learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional competence requires personal participation and contextual reflection.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing material access supports participation without removing an established manual operation here.
tasks.still_hard: Applying professional learning appropriately to individual kindergarten pupils.
tasks.human_edge: Learn, reflect and exchange practical experience with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: No change to professional learning responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: attending professional education requires personal reading and participation; an attendee-owned progress report is not inherent to each event.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is participation with direct material access, not choosing and booking an external conference. The provider produces the actual materials; teacher reading remains counted.

Before zero, inspect course lookup, registration, written reflections, certificates and sends. None is established in this attendance-only scenario. Add any actual booking or required written output before estimating that broader workflow.
Native access is tested first and already direct. No new learning log is introduced and automatic completion runtime earns no credit. No implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual registration and written reflection duties
research_questions: Observe a professional event and separate actual registration, preparation and required writing from participation.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 15 material-reading and 85 participation points. New special-education methods still require full personal learning; no real repeated entry, required report or send is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform library assistance and pupil-monitoring duties

steps.what: Verify the actual pupil, library book and requested library assistance
Enter and check the existing school-library loan record
Perform administrative hall and cafeteria monitoring with the actual pupils
Supervise and assist safe bus loading and unloading

tasks.design: Test native identifier lookup or barcode entry in the school-library application in {OTHER}. Remove repeated identifier typing within an actual loan transaction, retaining pupil/book checks, transaction verification and all hall, cafeteria and bus supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small library-record entry component accompanies predominantly physical supervision duties.
tasks.enabler_now: Native identifier lookup can reuse verified book and borrower IDs.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping pupils safe and supporting their individual needs during transitions.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the actual children and respond immediately to safety or support needs.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less library entry with unchanged pupil-supervision duties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: library applications support identifier lookup or barcode entry, while supervising young pupils remains physical human work.

assumptions: Provisional duty mix includes actual teacher-owned library loan entry as well as monitoring; it is not a measured school baseline. A monitoring-only assignment has no library benefit and needs reweighting. OTHER is the school-library application.

Existing library owners provide book and borrower identifiers; the teacher verifies them in s1. s2 retains lookup/scan effort, manual fallback for missing labels, full transaction checking and ordinary save. No new tagging or scanner capture is assumed free.

Native lookup is tested first. Only 2 of 10 repeated identifier-typing points are removed; 8 remain. Existing automated checkout runtime earns no saving. Excess missing-label repair lowers the estimate.

The loan record already serves the librarian and borrowers, not a new teacher-activity log. Ordinary loan saves are fully retained and ungated; no new hall, cafeteria or bus-monitoring record is invented.
unknowns: Actual teacher-owned library transaction duty and existing lookup
research_questions: Observe an actual duty cycle and time library identifier typing separately from safety supervision.

incremental.description: Check changed library identifier mappings and lookup failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2 identifier-typing points less 0.6 upkeep. Unlabelled books require manual entry; reuse only 0.8 points of known borrower identifiers and compatible book lookup: 0.8 minus 0.6 = 0.2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit schools to tutor sensory-impaired pupils and consult teachers

steps.what: Read the actual pupil's access needs and the receiving teacher's questions
Travel to the school for the actual sensory-support visit
Tutor the actual student with sensory impairments in the school setting
Consult the receiving teachers about the student's actual special needs

tasks.design: Retain the school visit, direct tutoring and teacher consultation, with actual preparation reading counted separately in {DOCS} and {LMS}. Native work access already supplies relevant context here, and the visit's physical and interpersonal work remains necessary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective sensory support depends on the actual pupil and school environment.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared native records support preparation without replacing the visit.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting support to the child's access needs and the receiving classroom.
tasks.human_edge: Observe real learning conditions and coach teachers in context.
tasks.altitude: No change to specialist visiting-teacher responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: sensory-support tutoring and consultation depend on direct pupil and classroom context; a visit does not inherently establish a separate activity-log requirement.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is one arranged visit with existing pupil information, not travel booking or formal assessment-report production. The teacher reads actual records personally; no free staff-written briefing is assumed.

Before zero, inspect arrangement messages, route lookup, written advice, pupil-plan amendments and reports. This scenario already has visit arrangements and direct record access but establishes no separate required written output. Add and assess any actual report or send before using zero for that broader workflow.
Native record access is assessed first. No repeated navigation baseline, new visit log or recording duty is introduced. Physical travel is retained; no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written advice or pupil-plan update required after a visit
research_questions: Observe a school visit and separate actual preparation, written outputs and sends from tutoring and consultation.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 context-reading, 20 travel, 50 tutoring and 20 consultation points. An unfamiliar pupil or classroom still needs full direct work; no real repeated record operation or required written output is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect accessible instruction and pupil safety while reducing only verified repeated equipment settings or library identifiers.
role.ambitious_version: No automated pupil assessment or additional classroom record requirement is proposed.
